bagPolicy.summary: The stadium regulations prohibit bulky luggage such as suitcases and equipment cases. Concert organisers may set additional bag restrictions and the stadium has no bag drop at its entry gates.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
